subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Creeps, Cache, & Corpses
email_body:
Hi Mary,

Your Katie and Maverick Cozy Mysteries pair an amateur sleuth with her loyal dog, and the newest installment, Creeps, Cache, & Corpses, looks like a fun addition to a series that already spans many books. It is a lovely mix of puzzles and pet companionship.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Creeps, Cache, & Corpses is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. This would be an optional add-on, entirely separate from the feature, and only if it feels useful for the series.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Creeps, Cache, & Corpses best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
